message.content: The dashboard **closely matches** the GAT Quiz reference design, successfully implementing the light theme with the navy/teal/gold color palette and clean white sidebar layout. The **top navigation bar is correctly styled in navy**, displaying the brand name, lesson timer, score chip with trophy icon, and ghost-style action buttons (Cover, Show Answers, Flashcards, PDF, Dark) as specified. The **white sidebar properly lists lessons** (1.1 through 1.5) with question counts and progress indicators, though visual progress bars appear subtle or text-based rather than prominent graphical bars. The **cover hero section features the animated navy-to-teal gradient background** with a gold badge header, large multi-color title (gold/orange text), comprehensive feature chips grid (6 Lessons, 73 Questions, MCQ Format, etc.), statistics row with gold numbers, and a prominent gold "Start Lesson 1.2" button. However, the **"Question of the Day" component with the gold NEW badge is not visible** in this view—it may be located below the fold or omitted from this specific screen state. Final minor issues to address include ensuring the sidebar progress bars are visually distinct/graphical and verifying that the Question of the Day section is implemented according to the reference design specifications.
